title: Reported: fictional characters may learn information outside their scenes
summary: Community reports describe long-running multi-character roleplay where shared summaries and lorebooks expose secrets to characters that should not know them. This is an anecdotal issue report, not a measured prevalence or proof that all existing tools fail.
verification_plan: Create a synthetic four-character scenario, reveal a unique fact to only one character, run repeated scene transitions with each frontend, and test whether factual prompts or summaries leak the fact; compare tools and memory settings.
